Have you ever noticed how, just when things start going really well—maybe at work, in a relationship, or even in your own personal growth—something inside you seems to throw on the brakes? It's almost like there's an invisible ceiling, quietly holding us back, no matter how much talent or drive we have.
Together, we're about to peel back the layers on these hidden barriers, inspired by Gay Hendricks' thought-provoking book, The Big Leap: Conquer Your Hidden Fear and Take Life to the Next Level. Hendricks calls this the "Upper Limit Problem"—those subtle, often unconscious beliefs and fears that kick in right when we're on the edge of something bigger, sparking self-sabotage just as our happiness and success begin to expand.
What if you could spot these patterns as they happen? Imagine understanding not just why we get stuck, but how to move beyond those old limits for good. That's what this journey is all about. We'll explore practical tools for catching self-doubt in the moment, and see how a shift in mindset and a little courage can open the door to your own "Zone of Genius"—that sweet spot where your passion and talents come alive. With each insight, you'll find new ways to invite more joy, creativity, and abundance into your life. So, if you're ready to break through and step into a deeper sense of purpose, let's dive in—together.
